title: Spicy Tadka Noodle Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy noodle stir fry made with tadka, adventurous spices, and noodles. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the tadka and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the onion, bell pepper, and ginger. Cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the garlic, adventurous spices, salt, and chili flakes. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the lime juice and stir to combine.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
